# DELETE /api/v1/user/hooks/{id}

Delete a webhook owned by the authenticated user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-151`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Webhooks disabled by administrator
- **404** — Webhook not found or not owned by user

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.DeleteHook | controller | Get hook ID from path; Call DeleteOwnerHook |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | utils.DeleteOwnerHook | utility | Call webhook.DeleteWebhookByOwnerID |
| 3 | [models](../modules/models.md) | webhook.DeleteWebhookByOwnerID | repository | Verify webhook exists by owner_id+id; Delete webhook by ID; Delete associated hook_task records |

| [webhook](../datastores/databases.md#webhook) | database | SELECT | Verify webhook exists |
| [webhook](../datastores/databases.md#webhook) | database | DELETE | Delete webhook record |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Webhooks must be enabled by administrator | authorization | setting.DisableWebhooks is true |
| Webhook deletion cascades to hook_task records | business_logic | Webhook is deleted |

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|

- **DB error** → utils.DeleteOwnerHook → 500
